sources.note: Main homepage. Product overview, AI-powered template-free charting, key feature highlights, awards (Capterra #1, HIMSS Davies Award).
ONC certification details (Version 9, cert date 2022-03-10), mandatory cost disclosures (Oracle DB license, Direct messaging costs), certified CQMs (40+), compound certification with EMR Direct.
Comprehensive feature list: Concept Processor, Datum+, PraxCoder, PraxDocs, DataMiner, Knowledge Exchanger, e-prescribing, patient portal, scheduling, telemedicine, billing integration, Smart Agents.
EHR system overview. AI concept processing, clinical decision support, PDMP integration, C-CDA support, patient demographics, lab integration, document scanning.

Company history. Founded by Dr. Richard Low (Yale grad, 20 years EM/IM). Development team in Argentina. SmithKline Beecham partnership for initial distribution. Version milestones: Praxis 1.0, 2.0 (1997), 3.0 (2005), 4.0 (Knowledge Exchanger). One of first 22 CCHIT-certified EMRs.

Integration directory. 30+ billing systems (Allscripts, athenaOne, Kareo/Tebra, Medisoft, etc.), 20+ labs (LabCorp, Quest, Dynacare), Surescripts eRx, MDToolbox, FIGmd reporting. All HL7-based, HIPAA compliant.

Patient portal details. AI-driven encounter-based content display, tailored intake forms, self-scheduling, care collaboration. Differentiator: shows only relevant info per encounter rather than everything.

Knowledge Exchanger feature. Peer-to-peer sharing of clinical knowledge bases: case presentations, diagnostic discussions, drug protocols, patient instructions, questionnaires. Available for all specialties.
Specialty support page. 90+ specialties listed including Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Dermatology, Gastroenterology, Pediatrics, Surgery, Psychiatry, Orthopedics, etc.

User testimonials from multiple specialties (Family Medicine, Cardiology, Endocrinology, Pediatrics, Surgery, GI, Pulmonology, Dermatology, Podiatry, Urgent Care, OB-GYN). Users report 40-second chart creation, 2-3 hours daily saved, HIMSS Davies Award case study with 45% revenue increase.
Cloud hosting option. RDP/RemoteApp access, HIPAA-compliant, encrypted. On-premise also available. Terminal server multi-user support.

Detailed third-party profile. Pricing: $219/mo for 60 months (lease-to-own). 4.9/5 rating, 185 reviews. Best for solo/small practices, concierge/DPC. Cons: steep learning curve, limited plug-and-play integrations, dated UI. 34 billing system interfaces listed.
Capterra profile page (403 on fetch but search results confirmed 4.9/5, 217 reviews, rated #1 EHR for Value 2024).
Market share data. Praxis EMR holds ~0.03% EHR market share. Very small vendor compared to MEDITECH, eClinicalWorks, etc.
Capterra 2024 Value award announcement. Second time winning. Emphasizes affordability + functionality for independent providers.
